text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, today's race.
Who are you rooting for, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ogurin, obviously!
Do your best! Oguriiin!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Until today, I'll be right here
watching you run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...However, next time...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No matter where I go, the cheers from the stands never stop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A star Umamusume who defined an era.
It seems that title is the real deal.
choice_data_list: Her ability is surely the real deal too.
Her ability is surely the real deal too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why my body burns, longing to break into a run...!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Heading to the paddock now too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Do you like onigiri?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When you're nervous, Tome-san's rice balls really do the trick.
Right now, I have about 10 spares in my waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The thought alone is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "...It is thanks to the support of so many people that I have been able to make it this far."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "My mother, who was the first to send me off, and the people who looked after me back in Kasamatsu."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And right now, the person cheering me on is...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I can't run in a way that betrays them.
That's why I want to get stronger."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's both give it our all.
